card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on a mix of word endings like istical, IVITY and intestinal, plus stray commas, 's and the word and.

modes.label: Word endings
modes.description: Late pieces of long words such as Anabaptistical, HYPERSENSITIVITY or Gastrointestinal.

modes.label: Stray small words
modes.description: Commas, 's, and or the in running prose of legal or historical text.
